items.title: 〈焦點股〉喬山越南新廠啟用助攻營運 拉出第2根漲停但未鎖住
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Jockey Sport's Vietnam New Factory Boosts Operations
paras: 健身器材廠喬山 (1736-TW) 越南二廠 JIV2 本周啟用，加上原先的越南一廠 JIV1，產能規模上看 6 億美元，越南基地將成為喬山全球最具規模的製造重鎮，進一步助攻營運，朝 2040 年營收規模百億美元目標邁進，激勵喬山今 (6) 日早盤一度拉出第二根漲停板。
喬山今天早盤以 136 元開高走高，盤中一度觸及漲停價 147.5 元，不過未鎖住，截至 10 點，股價暫報 145 元，仍大漲逾半根停板，收復年線，成交量超過 1000 張。
喬山越南二廠斥資 7000 萬美元打造，位於越南北寧省，距離越南一廠僅需 9 分鐘車程，基地面積約 20 萬平方米。喬山指出，越南二廠引進自動化、數位化生產流程，並實現關鍵零組件 100% 自製化，提升產品交期彈性與品質。
喬山指出，越南二廠主要生產健身器材與關鍵零組件，健身器材包括商用及家用有氧設備、健身房專用飛輪與重訓設備，關鍵零組件則涵蓋跑步機馬達、電子控制面板、跑板、跑帶，以及其他器材關鍵零件。
喬山進一步點出越南二廠對於公司的戰略地位，除可提升全球供貨能力、分散製造風險外，也可縮短交貨時間，提高供應鏈韌性。
paras_en: Jockey Sport (1736-TW) has put its second factory in Vietnam, JIV2, into operation this week, increasing its production capacity to $6 billion. The Vietnam base will become Jockey Sport's largest manufacturing hub globally, further supporting operations and helping the company move towards its goal of $1 billion in revenue by 2040. This has driven Jockey Sport's stock price up to a second limit-up on June 6.

Jockey Sport's stock price rose to 136 yuan at the opening and reached a high of 147.5 yuan during the trading session, but failed to hold the limit-up price. As of 10 am, the stock price was 145 yuan, still up more than half a limit-up, and has recovered the year's line. The trading volume exceeded 1,000 shares.

Jockey Sport's second factory in Vietnam, JIV2, was built at a cost of $70 million and is located in the northern province of Vietnam, just 9 minutes' drive from the first factory. The factory covers an area of approximately 200,000 square meters. Jockey Sport said that the second factory has introduced automated and digitalized production processes and has achieved 100% self-manufacturing of key components, improving product delivery flexibility and quality.

Jockey Sport said that the second factory mainly produces fitness equipment and key components. The fitness equipment includes commercial and home aerobic equipment, fitness center-specific exercise bikes and strength training equipment. Key components include treadmill motors, electronic control panels, running belts, and other critical parts.

Jockey Sport further pointed out that the second factory in Vietnam has enhanced the company's strategic position, enabling it to improve global supply capacity, diversify manufacturing risks, shorten delivery times, and increase supply chain resilience.

items.title: 〈房產〉北台灣7月新案買氣未振作  住展風向球燈號依舊閃衰退黃藍燈
items.title_en: Taiwan's Northern Region Sees Uninspiring New Property Sales in July
paras: 代表北台灣新建案市況的「住展風向球」，7 月燈號依然是衰退黃藍燈，分數微進步，爲 35.5 分，六大構成項目為「二升、四平」，預售屋推案量、新成屋戶數上升，來客組數、成交組數、議價率、待售建案數分數持平。
住展企研室總監暨發言人陳炳辰表示，7 月逢暑假出遊、颱風季節等不利匯聚買氣因素，雖然供給量月增，不再像前月失控探底，但預售案量僅比 6 月成長逾 200 億元，而達 400 億元，較去年同期年減 30%，淡季時節同時大環境沒有利多，難以提振太多建商推案信心，以新北市中和區、三重區，與桃園市中壢區的寶亞、愛山林 (2540-TW)、裕隆建設案為勇於推案登場的指標。
統計顯示，7 月新成屋戶數亦走增，總計新公開超過 400 戶，比前月增加了 300 戶，以新北市三重區的瓏山林建設案就貢獻了 200 多戶為最大助攻力道，卻也顯示餘案戶數不多，過去獵地申請建造熱潮，不乏建商規劃先建後售產品，如今即使面對冷氣團，砸下的大量興建資金在完工後勢必得公開銷售，逆勢登場背後有時是不得不推的苦衷。
銷況不佳下，7 月待售案數登上 1600 案，然議價率始終保持在一成內，部分新案開價雖已自主修正，像待售量體較多的桃園市，如今在 A7、A20 等捷運站地帶熱門房市區都傳出知名新案價格平實，不再走高，但也以區域行情為依歸，無法大幅度讓步，開價與成交價空間拉不開，去化牛步，等不到結案又得開案，逐步到來的交屋潮，是否伴隨解約轉股市的危機，建商賣壓值得關注。
陳炳辰指出，2026 年影響房市因素除了未解的限貸與打房政策外，還有股市的強大吸金能量，雖然近期台股起伏大，市場仍對第四季的股市抱以相當大的樂觀度，且選舉將至，預期政策面不願直接刺激房市轉強，恐也引不起資金對房市的興趣。
paras_en: The 'Residential Market Trend Ball' indicator for northern Taiwan's new property market remained in a declining yellow-blue light in July, with a score of 35.5, a slight improvement from the previous month. The six components were 'two upgrades, four flat', with pre-sale property listings and new completed units increasing, while visitor numbers, transaction numbers, and negotiation rates remained unchanged.

Residential Market Research Center Director and Spokesperson Chen Ping-chen said that July's poor sales were due to factors such as the summer vacation season and typhoon season, which made it difficult to attract buyers. Although supply increased, it was no longer as out of control as in the previous month, but pre-sale property listings only grew by over NT$20 billion, reaching NT$40 billion, a 30% decrease from the same period last year. With no favorable market conditions during the off-season, it was difficult to boost the confidence of property developers to launch new projects, with the exception of the Yuanta, Evergreen (2540-TW), and Ruentex projects in New Taipei City's Zhonghe and Tucheng districts, and Taoyuan City's Zhongli District.

Statistics showed that new completed unit sales also increased in July, with over 400 new units listed, a 300-unit increase from the previous month. The largest contributor was the Ruentex project in New Taipei City's Tucheng District, which added over 200 units. However, this also highlighted the limited number of remaining units, as many developers had previously applied for land use permits during the construction boom, and were now forced to launch their products despite the cold market.

Despite poor sales, the number of unsold properties reached 1,600 in July, with negotiation rates remaining at around 1%. Although some new projects had adjusted their prices, many unsold properties in Taoyuan City, such as those near the A7 and A20 metro stations, were reported to have stable prices, with no significant discounts. However, prices were still influenced by regional market conditions, and developers were unable to make significant concessions. As the market continues to cool down, the risk of a wave of cancellations and stock market fluctuations is a concern.

Chen Ping-chen pointed out that, in addition to the unresolved loan restrictions and anti-speculation policies, the strong stock market's ability to attract funds will also impact the property market in 2026. Although the Taiwan Stock Exchange has been volatile in recent times, the market remains optimistic about the fourth quarter, and the upcoming election may lead to a cautious approach to stimulating the property market, which may not attract investors' interest.

items.title: 貝佐斯今年來首次減持亞馬遜股票 套現3.5億美元
items.title_en: Bezos Sells Amazon Stock for First Time This Year, Cashes Out $350 Million
paras: 美國電商巨擘亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 股價周一（3 日）創紀錄新高之際，創辦人貝佐斯出售價值近 3.5 億美元的亞馬遜股票，這是他今年來首次出售亞馬遜股份。
據《彭博》周四報導，美股周三盤後發布的 Form 4 申報文件中披露了這筆交易。這位億萬富豪兩天前在另一份文件中表示，計畫出售最多 1,500 萬股亞馬遜股票，價值超過 40 億美元，此次出售僅占該計畫一小部分。
今年來亞馬遜股價勁漲 18%，貝佐斯的財富增加了 387 億美元，達到 2,920 億美元。亞馬遜上周公布雲端運算業務營收表現強勁後，成為全球第五家市值突破 3 兆美元的公司。
貝佐斯此次售股後，仍以 8.16% 的持股比例遙遙領先，是亞馬遜最大股東。
貝佐斯近年來加快出售亞馬遜股票。自 2020 年以來，他便出售了價值超過 380 億美元的股份。相比之下，從亞馬遜 1997 年首次公開募股到 2020 年之前，他累計出售的股票不到 100 億美元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. e‑commerce giant Amazon (AMZN‑US) saw its share price hit a record high on Monday (the 3rd), and founder Jeff Bezos sold Amazon stock worth nearly $350 million, marking his first sale of Amazon shares this year.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday, a Form 4 filing released after market close on Wednesday disclosed the transaction. The billionaire had indicated two days earlier in another filing that he planned to sell up to 15 million Amazon shares, valued at over $4 billion, and this sale represents only a small portion of that plan.

Amazon’s stock has surged 18% so far this year, boosting Bezos’s wealth by $38.7 billion to $292 billion. After Amazon reported strong cloud‑computing revenue last week, it became the world’s fifth company with a market value exceeding $3 trillion.
After this sale, Bezos still holds an 8.16% stake, remaining far ahead as Amazon’s largest shareholder.

Bezos has accelerated his Amazon stock sales in recent years. Since 2020 he has sold shares worth more than $38 billion. By contrast, from Amazon’s IPO in 1997 up to 2020 he sold less than $10 billion worth of stock.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication.)

items.title: 伊朗總統：目前很難與最高領袖穆吉塔巴聯繫
items.title_en: Iran President: Currently Difficult to Contact Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei
paras: 伊朗總統裴澤斯基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 週三 (6 日) 表示，目前與最高領袖穆吉塔巴 · 哈米尼 (Mojtaba Khamenei) 保持聯繫「非常困難」，但強調對方依然是伊朗的重要精神支柱，在國家面臨外部壓力之際具有關鍵凝聚作用。
裴澤斯基安是在就職兩週年接受伊朗國營電視台專訪時作出上述表示。裴澤斯基安表示：「目前要與他 (穆吉塔巴) 聯繫非常困難，但無論如何，他的存在對我們而言都是極大的精神支柱，讓我們得以繼續前進。」
他指出，政府官員越能坦率向最高領袖說明問題，彼此就越容易建立共識並形成一致決策。
談及穆吉塔巴時，裴澤斯基安形容他是一位「非凡的人物」，並表示自己對其品格、謙遜態度及理性判斷留下深刻印象。
針對近期國內輿論，裴澤斯基安批評，有人藉由最高領袖對美伊合作備忘錄的立場刻意製造內部分裂。他指出，穆吉塔巴最終公開支持這項協議，儘管一開始曾抱持保留態度。
這份共 14 點的美伊合作備忘錄於 2026 年 6 月 17 日，由美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 與裴澤斯基安簽署，內容包括正式停火、解除海上封鎖及停止雙方軍事行動，目的在為後續和平談判建立框架。
裴澤斯基安表示，伊朗目前正承受來自外部日益升高的壓力，包括制裁與軍事對抗，對手試圖藉此激化民眾不滿情緒，甚至鼓動示威抗議。他形容，這是自 1979 年伊斯蘭革命以來，伊朗面臨最艱難的時期。
穆吉塔巴於今年 3 月 8 日接任伊朗最高領袖，其父親、前最高領袖阿里 · 哈米尼 (Ali Khamenei) 於 2 月 28 日在德黑蘭遭美國與以色列聯合空襲身亡。
伊朗領導層交接期間，美伊軍事衝突持續升溫。伊朗曾以飛彈及無人機攻擊駐有美軍基地的波灣國家作為報復，雙方隨後於 4 月達成停火，並在巴基斯坦斡旋下於 6 月簽署合作備忘錄，盼為終結衝突與推動長期和平奠定基礎。
不過，這項協議於上月破裂，美伊再度爆發近兩週的軍事衝突，直到傳出雙方重新展開談判後，川普才下令停止空襲，使戰事暫時降溫。
paras_en: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated on Wednesday (6th) that it is currently 'very difficult' to maintain contact with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, but emphasized that he remains an important spiritual pillar for Iran, playing a crucial role in uniting the nation in the face of external pressure.

Pezeshkian made the statement during an interview with Iran's state-run television on the occasion of his two-year presidency. He said, 'It is very difficult to contact him (Mojtaba) now, but regardless, his presence is a huge spiritual pillar for us, allowing us to continue moving forward.'
He pointed out that government officials are more likely to establish consensus and make unified decisions when they are honest with the Supreme Leader about the problems they face.
When discussing Mojtaba, Pezeshkian described him as an 'extraordinary person' and expressed his deep impression of Mojtaba's character, humility, and rational judgment.

In response to recent domestic opinion, Pezeshkian criticized some people for intentionally creating internal divisions by taking advantage of the Supreme Leader's stance on the US-Iran cooperation memorandum. He noted that Mojtaba ultimately publicly supported the agreement, despite initially having reservations.

The 14-point US-Iran cooperation memorandum, signed on June 17, 2026, by US President Donald Trump and Pezeshkian, includes formal ceasefire, lifting of naval blockade, and cessation of military actions, with the aim of establishing a framework for future peace talks.

Pezeshkian stated that Iran is currently facing increasing external pressure, including sanctions and military confrontation, with opponents trying to fuel public discontent and even incite protests. He described this as the most difficult period Iran has faced since the 1979 Islamic Revolution.

Mojtaba took over as Iran's Supreme Leader on March 8 this year, following the death of his father, former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, who was killed in a joint US-Israeli airstrike in Tehran on February 28.

During the transition of power in Iran, the military conflict between the US and Iran escalated. Iran had retaliated by launching missiles and drones at US military bases in Gulf countries, followed by a ceasefire in April and the signing of the cooperation memorandum in June, facilitated by Pakistan, in the hope of establishing a foundation for ending the conflict and promoting long-term peace.

However, the agreement broke down last month, leading to a near two-week military conflict between the US and Iran, which only subsided after Trump ordered a halt to airstrikes following reports of renewed negotiations.

items.title: Yardeni：AI交易進入成果導向時代 市場不再為題材埋單
items.title_en: Yardeni: AI Trading Enters Outcome-Oriented Era, Market No Longer Blindly Buys Hyperscalers
paras: Yardeni Research 最新報告指出，投資人已不再像 AI 浪潮初期一樣，對大型雲端服務商 (Hyperscalers) 的 AI 布局照單全收，而是開始依據各家公司實際的資本支出、已簽約訂單及雲端業務成長表現，重新評估投資價值。
AI 投資熱潮正在進入新階段，最新報告指出，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 四大雲端業者 2026 會計年度合計資本支出預計約達 6,000 億美元，較 2025 會計年度的 3,090 億美元大幅增加。
受到電力供應、設備交付及地方政府許可等因素影響，不少資料中心建設時程已延後至 2027 年甚至更晚，但 Yardeni 認為，這代表的是建設時程遞延，而非企業縮減 AI 投資。
Yardeni 引用研究機構 Sightline Climate 的統計指出，目前追蹤的 777 個大型資料中心計畫中，真正取消的僅有 9 個，顯示 AI 基礎建設投資仍持續推進，整體需求並未出現明顯退潮。
除了持續擴大資本支出之外，四大雲端業者手中也握有龐大的未履約合約 (RPO)。
截至 2026 會計年度，四家公司合計未履約合約規模已超過 2.3 兆美元，其中微軟約 6,780 億美元居冠，甲骨文則約 6,380 億美元，代表未來仍有大量已簽約、尚未認列的收入可望逐步實現。
不過，Yardeni 也提醒，市場仍須留意客戶集中風險，尤其 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 是否能如期履行龐大的算力採購承諾。
標普全球評級 (S&P Global Ratings) 今年 7 月便以甲骨文對 OpenAI 依賴程度較高為由，將其信用評等調降至 BBB-，反映市場對相關風險的擔憂。
報告也指出，AI 基礎建設的資金來源正出現變化。
過去大型雲端業者多仰賴自身營運現金流支應資本支出，但隨著投資規模快速擴大，自由現金流已不足以完全支撐。
Alphabet 於 2026 年第二季首次出現單季自由現金流轉負，亞馬遜截至 6 月底的近 12 個月自由現金流亦轉為流出 76 億美元。
根據高盛估算，2025 年大型雲端業者約有 26% 的資本支出透過外部融資 (主要為舉債) 支應，預估 2026 年將升至 33%，2027 年則可能進一步提高至約 35%，顯示 AI 投資更加地依賴外部資金。
儘管投入成本持續增加，各家雲端業務仍維持強勁成長。微軟 Cloud 2026 會計年度營收達 2,143 億美元，年增 27%；AWS 截至 6 月底近四季累計營收 1,347 億美元，年增 50%；Google Cloud 營收 777 億美元，年增 60%；Oracle Cloud 營收 340 億美元，年增 39%。
Yardeni 表示，市場如今已不再將大型雲端業者視為同一投資族群，而是根據各家公司 AI 投資策略、未履約訂單規模及實際雲端營收表現逐一評價。
以今年股價表現來看，甲骨文因自由現金流惡化及對 OpenAI 高度依賴的疑慮，今年以來股價仍下跌 28%；微軟則在雲端業績優於預期後收復部分跌幅；Alphabet 今年累計上漲 20%，亞馬遜在 AWS 財報帶動下，今年以來亦上漲約 18%。
Yardeni 總結指出，AI 投資主軸已經發生根本轉變，市場不再僅憑對 AI 前景的期待給予高估值，而是更加重視企業是否真正展現出營收成長、訂單能見度以及資本投入所帶來的實際成果。
paras_en: Yardeni Research's latest report indicates that investors are no longer blindly following the AI wave, as they did in its early stages, and are instead reassessing investment values based on actual capital expenditures, signed contracts, and cloud business growth.

The AI investment frenzy is entering a new phase, with the report indicating that Amazon (AMZN-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), and Oracle (ORCL-US) will collectively spend around $600 billion on capital expenditures in 2026, a significant increase from $309 billion in 2025.

Despite delays in data center construction due to factors such as power supply, equipment delivery, and local government permits, Yardeni believes this represents a delay in construction schedules rather than a reduction in AI investment.

According to Sightline Climate, a research institution, only 9 out of 777 large data center projects have been canceled, indicating that AI infrastructure investment continues to push forward, with no significant decline in demand.
In addition to increasing capital expenditures, the four major cloud providers also have massive unpaid contracts (RPOs) in hand.

As of 2026, the total value of unpaid contracts for the four companies exceeds $2.3 trillion, with Microsoft leading the pack at around $678 billion, followed by Oracle at around $638 billion, indicating a large amount of future revenue that will be gradually realized.

However, Yardeni also warns that market participants should be cautious of customer concentration risks, particularly with OpenAI and Anthropic's ability to fulfill their massive computing power procurement commitments.
In July, S&P Global Ratings downgraded Oracle's credit rating to BBB- due to its high dependence on OpenAI, reflecting market concerns about related risks.
The report also notes that the funding sources for AI infrastructure are changing.

In the past, large cloud providers relied heavily on their own operating cash flows to fund capital expenditures, but as investment scales rapidly, free cash flow is no longer sufficient to fully support it.
Alphabet reported a negative free cash flow in the second quarter of 2026, and Amazon's free cash flow turned negative in the 12 months ending June 30, totaling $76 billion.

According to Goldman Sachs estimates, in 2025, large cloud providers relied on external financing (mainly debt) for around 26% of their capital expenditures, which is expected to rise to 33% in 2026 and potentially reach around 35% in 2027, indicating that AI investment is becoming increasingly dependent on external funding.

Despite increasing costs, cloud businesses continue to maintain strong growth. Microsoft Cloud's revenue reached $214 billion in 2026, a 27% increase year-over-year; AWS reported $134.7 billion in revenue over the past four quarters, a 50% increase year-over-year; Google Cloud's revenue reached $77.7 billion, a 60% increase year-over-year; and Oracle Cloud's revenue reached $34 billion, a 39% increase year-over-year.

Yardeni notes that the market is no longer viewing large cloud providers as a single investment group, but rather evaluating each company based on its AI investment strategy, unpaid contract size, and actual cloud revenue performance.

Looking at this year's stock performance, Oracle's stock has fallen 28% due to concerns about its free cash flow and high dependence on OpenAI, while Microsoft has recovered some of its losses after its cloud business exceeded expectations; Alphabet's stock has risen 20% this year, and Amazon's stock has risen around 18% this year, driven by AWS's strong earnings.

Yardeni concludes that the main axis of AI investment has undergone a fundamental shift, with the market no longer relying solely on expectations of AI's future prospects to assign high valuations, but rather focusing on whether companies are actually demonstrating revenue growth, order visibility, and the actual results of capital investment.

items.title: 輝達急尋中國AI基地台供應商 明後年啟動端側算力組網
items.title_en: Nvidia Urgently Seeking Chinese AI Base Station Supplier, Plans Edge Computing Network Launch in Next One to Two Years
paras: 美國晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 正在中國急尋 AI 基地台供應商，開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台（既負責通訊連接，又能承擔 AI 運算的基地台）。
通訊產業鏈核心人士透露，輝達正在加速進入電信市場，並在中國尋找基地台廠商合作方，開發符合海外市場要求的 6G 基地台。
據《界面新聞》6 日（周四）報導，該人士形容，輝達在找端側算力的「下一個中際旭創」，因為輝達認為，算力接下來要從資料中心傳輸到海量的 AI 終端和用戶，最終需要依賴基地台的無線傳輸。
上述人士稱，輝達推動這一項目的節奏「比較緊迫」，希望在 2027 或 2028 年進入試驗網。
據《界面新聞》報導，深圳佳賢通信是輝達正在建立的基地台合作方之一，其內部人士證實，輝達從 2025 年就與公司接觸，雙方正基於輝達 CUDA 生態合作開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台，雙方合作已持續半年多。
「佳賢通信和輝達已經組建了專門工作組。輝達方面有十餘人參與其中，成員分布在新加坡、香港及中國內地。目前工作組正圍繞輝達 CUDA 系統的開源生態進行研究。」佳賢通信相關人士說。
佳賢通信成立於 2011 年，總部位於深圳，是一家 AI-RAN 無線通訊產品及解決方案提供商。
據《界面新聞》報導，佳賢通信與輝達的合作進入技術研發階段，不排除成立商業主體，聯合進行海外拓展。
「首先在技術層面，我們已經開始合作。」佳賢通信相關人士表示，目前在雙方的合作中，輝達並不直接生產和銷售完整基地台，而是以晶片和技術生態的方式參與，即基地台公司採購輝達 GPU，並基於輝達 CUDA 生態開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台，完成產品後，再向海外市場銷售。
「預計今年年底跟輝達開發的 AI 基地台樣機就會出來，在驗證通過後，一兩年內就會推向市場。」上述人士說。
對輝達來說，AI 基地台是一門不亞於算力資料中心的好生意。
AI 1.0 階段，算力主要集中在資料中心，輝達銷售大量 GPU；AI 應用落地 2.0 階段，端側算力應用空間更為廣闊，輝達希望邊緣和端側算力也採用其晶片，因此布局 AI 基地台，是輝達為即將到來的端側算力做準備。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US), the U.S. chip giant, is urgently looking for AI base station suppliers in China to develop 6G AI‑RAN base stations that handle both communications connectivity and AI computing.

Industry insiders in the telecom supply chain say Nvidia is accelerating its entry into the telecom market and is seeking Chinese base‑station partners to develop 6G stations that meet overseas market requirements.

According to a report by Jiemian News on Thursday the 6th, the source described Nvidia as searching for the “next Zhongji Xuchuang” for edge computing, because Nvidia believes future compute will shift from data centers to massive AI endpoints and users, ultimately relying on wireless transmission via base stations.
The source said Nvidia’s pace for this project is “quite urgent,” hoping to enter a trial network in 2027 or 2028.

Jiemian News reported that Shenzhen Jiashen Communications is one of the base‑station partners Nvidia is establishing; an insider confirmed Nvidia has been in contact with the company since 2025 and the two have been co‑developing a 6G AI‑RAN base station based on Nvidia’s CUDA ecosystem for over half a year.

“Jiashen Communications and Nvidia have formed a dedicated working group. More than ten Nvidia staff are involved, located in Singapore, Hong Kong and mainland China. The group is currently researching around Nvidia’s open‑source CUDA ecosystem,” said a Jiashen Communications representative.
Jiashen Communications was founded in 2011, is headquartered in Shenzhen, and provides AI‑RAN wireless communication products and solutions.
Jiemian News said the cooperation between Jiashen Communications and Nvidia has entered the technical R&D stage, and a commercial entity may be formed to jointly pursue overseas expansion.

“On the technical side, we have already started cooperating,” said the Jiashen representative. Currently Nvidia does not directly manufacture or sell complete base stations; instead it participates through chips and its technology ecosystem, with the base‑station maker purchasing Nvidia GPUs and developing 6G AI‑RAN stations on the CUDA platform, then selling the finished products overseas.
“We expect a prototype AI base station developed with Nvidia to be ready by the end of this year; after validation, it should reach the market within one to two years,” the source added.
For Nvidia, AI base stations represent a business as significant as data‑center compute.

In the AI 1.0 era, compute was concentrated in data centers and Nvidia sold large volumes of GPUs; in the AI 2.0 era, edge and endpoint compute opportunities are far broader, and Nvidia wants its chips to be used there as well, so its push into AI base stations is preparation for the upcoming wave of edge computing.

items.title: 2026年晶片預測：銷量暴增98.3% 直逼1.7兆美元
items.title_en: 2026 Chip Forecast: Sales to Surge 98.3% to Nearly $1.7 Trillion
paras: 半導體產業正步入一個非凡的成長階段，其主要驅動力是 AI 基礎設施，以及先進邏輯與記憶體元件供應的嚴重瓶頸。根據《麥克林報告》（McClean Report）2026 年 6 月更新版，全球半導體市場預計將在 2026 年成長 98.3%，達到約 1.7 兆美元，並在 2027 年進一步擴張至超過 2.2 兆美元。
這並非正常的週期性復甦，而是反映出 AI 資料中心快速建設所帶動的市場需求結構性轉變。在這些資料中心中，GPU、高頻寬記憶體（HBM）、先進 DRAM、NAND 快閃記憶體、先進晶圓代工產能以及先進封裝技術，都已成為供應瓶頸。
從技術角度來看，最重要的驅動因素是記憶體。報告預測，到 2026 年，記憶體市場規模將成長 298%，達到 9,164 億美元。這一成長主要由價格帶動：記憶體出貨量預計僅增加 8%，但平均售價預計將上漲 268%。
這種差距至關重要，代表業界並非只是賣出更多晶片，而是以更高的價格出售稀缺且具有戰略價值的晶片。
HBM 正是這波成長的核心，因為 AI 加速器需要極高的記憶體頻寬，才能在訓練與推論期間，持續為 GPU 提供大量資料。HBM 採用垂直堆疊記憶體，並透過先進封裝技術連接，因此可提供遠高於傳統記憶體架構的頻寬。
然而，HBM 的崛起也帶來產能取捨。報告指出，相同容量的 HBM 所需晶圓面積約為標準 DDR5 的三倍，製造成本也約為其四倍。隨著三星、SK 海力士及美光等業者將更多晶圓產能轉向 HBM，主流 DRAM 供應也隨之趨緊。
這不僅推升 HBM 價格，也帶動 PC、伺服器、智慧型手機、汽車系統及工業電子所使用的非 HBM DRAM 價格同步上漲。這也意味著，AI 需求正影響整體科技供應鏈，而不只是 AI 硬體供應商。
邏輯晶片同樣受惠於這波趨勢。MOS 邏輯市場預計到 2026 年將成長 32%，達到 5,775 億美元，其中 GPU 將成為主要成長引擎。GPU 營收預計於 2026 年成長 31%，主要受惠於出貨量增加及平均售價提高。
這些 GPU 是 AI 資料中心的運算核心，透過平行運算執行 Transformer 模型訓練、推論、模擬，以及機器人、汽車、醫療保健等領域日益普及的實體 AI（Physical AI）應用。
此外，微處理器（MPU）與微控制器（MCU）也預計恢復成長，受惠於作業系統升級、工業需求回溫，以及汽車市場持續穩健。
這之所以重要，是因為半導體產業正從單純的零組件產業，逐步轉變為具有戰略地位的核心產業。
如今，晶片已決定人工智慧部署、雲端運算擴張、自主系統、機器人、醫療設備、智慧基礎設施及先進消費性電子產品的發展速度。
如果到了 2027 年，先進晶圓產能、高頻寬記憶體供應、光刻設備及先進封裝技術仍持續受限，擁有穩定供應協議的企業將具備顯著競爭優勢。相反地，依賴現貨市場採購或仰賴通用記憶體的企業，可能面臨更高成本、更長交期，以及產品延後上市等挑戰。
報告也提出一項值得關注的問題：這究竟只是短暫的超級週期，還是永久性的結構性變革？
歷史上，半導體產業每次景氣繁榮，往往最終都因供應商過度擴產，導致供給過剩及價格崩跌。《麥克林報告》也坦言，2028 年至 2029 年間仍存在這項風險。
不過，報告同時指出，人工智慧可能代表一個更持久的需求來源。如果 AI 推論工作負載持續擴展至消費市場、企業、工業及邊緣運算領域，即使新增產能陸續開出，半導體需求仍可能維持高檔。
實際上，半導體市場已不再只是圍繞個人電腦與智慧型手機的景氣循環，而是愈來愈聚焦於全球人工智慧基礎設施建設的競賽。
這也使得記憶體頻寬、GPU 供應能力、先進封裝，以及領先製程能力，成為衡量未來科技發展、企業競爭力與經濟成長的重要指標。
paras_en: The semiconductor industry is entering an extraordinary growth phase, driven primarily by AI infrastructure and the severe shortage of advanced logic and memory components. According to the McClean Report updated in June 2026, the global semiconductor market is expected to grow by 98.3% in 2026, reaching approximately $1.7 trillion, and further expand to over $2.2 trillion in 2027.

This is not a normal cyclical recovery, but rather a reflection of the structural change in market demand driven by the rapid construction of AI data centers. In these data centers, GPUs, high-bandwidth memory (HBM), advanced DRAM, NAND flash memory, advanced wafer production capacity, and advanced packaging technologies have become supply bottlenecks.

From a technical perspective, the most important driver is memory. The report predicts that the memory market will grow by 298% by 2026, reaching $916.4 billion. This growth is mainly driven by price: memory shipments are expected to increase by only 8%, but the average selling price is expected to rise by 268%.
This gap is crucial, representing that the industry is not just selling more chips, but selling scarce and strategically valuable chips at a higher price.

HBM is at the core of this growth, as AI accelerators require extremely high memory bandwidth to continuously provide large amounts of data to GPUs during training and inference. HBM uses vertically stacked memory and connects through advanced packaging technology, providing much higher bandwidth than traditional memory architectures.

However, the rise of HBM also brings production trade-offs. The report points out that the same capacity of HBM requires about three times the wafer area of standard DDR5 and costs about four times as much to produce. As manufacturers such as Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron allocate more wafer production capacity to HBM, mainstream DRAM supply is also becoming tighter.

This not only drives up HBM prices but also pushes up the prices of non-HBM DRAM used in PCs, servers, smartphones, automotive systems, and industrial electronics. This means that AI demand is affecting the entire tech supply chain, not just AI hardware suppliers.

Logic chips are also benefiting from this trend. The MOS logic market is expected to grow by 32% by 2026, reaching $57.75 billion, with GPUs becoming the main growth engine. GPU revenue is expected to grow by 31% in 2026, mainly driven by increased shipments and higher average prices.

These GPUs are the computing core of AI data centers, executing Transformer model training, inference, simulation, and physical AI applications in areas such as robotics, automotive, healthcare, and more, through parallel computing.
Additionally, microprocessors (MPUs) and microcontrollers (MCUs) are also expected to recover, driven by operating system upgrades, industrial demand, and a stable automotive market.
This is important because the semiconductor industry is transitioning from a simple component industry to a strategically positioned core industry.
Today, chips determine the development speed of AI deployment, cloud computing expansion, autonomous systems, robotics, medical devices, smart infrastructure, and advanced consumer electronics.

If advanced wafer production capacity, high-bandwidth memory supply, lithography equipment, and advanced packaging technologies remain constrained by 2027, companies with stable supply agreements will have a significant competitive advantage. In contrast, companies relying on spot market purchases or general memory may face higher costs, longer lead times, and delayed product launches.
The report also raises a question worth noting: is this just a short-term super cycle or a permanent structural change?

Historically, every semiconductor industry boom has eventually ended due to suppliers over-expanding, leading to oversupply and price crashes. The McClean Report also acknowledges that this risk still exists between 2028 and 2029.

However, the report also points out that artificial intelligence may represent a more sustainable source of demand. If AI inference workloads continue to expand into consumer, enterprise, industrial, and edge computing markets, even with new production capacity coming online, semiconductor demand may remain high.
In fact, the semiconductor market is no longer just about the PC and smartphone cycles, but is increasingly focused on the global competition for AI infrastructure construction.

This also makes memory bandwidth, GPU supply capability, advanced packaging, and leading-edge process capabilities important indicators for measuring future technological development, corporate competitiveness, and economic growth.

items.title: 馬斯克大讚「最好的AI晶片」輝達逆勢連五紅
items.title_en: Musk Praises 'Best AI Chip' Nvidia as Stock Surges
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 股價周三 (5 日) 逆勢走高，在整體晶片族群走弱之際，連續第五個交易日收紅。
在 SpaceX 首次舉行的財報電話會議中，執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 大力讚揚輝達的 AI 晶片，成為推升股價的重要催化劑。
馬斯克稱讚，輝達即將推出的 Vera Rubin 晶片架構是「最好的」，並透露 SpaceX「已決定將全面採用輝達產品」。
他表示，「我們認為，它是最好的 AI 電腦，我們也非常珍惜與輝達在多個層面的緊密合作夥伴關係。」
稍後在電話會議中，馬斯克進一步表示，SpaceX 已與輝達達成共識，「明年將取得其相當高比例的 GPU」。輝達目前仍主導 GPU 市場，主要競爭對手為 AMD(AMD-US)。
輝達股價周三上漲 3.4%，已連續五個交易日收高，這段期間累計漲幅達 15.4%。
SpaceX 算力擴張可望成輝達一大動能
馬斯克表示，SpaceX 預計今年底前將建置超過 2GW 的 AI 算力，並計劃在 2027 年底前將算力提升至接近 10GW。
Wolfe Research 分析師 Chris Caso 指出，若以輝達每新增 1GW 已部署晶片可帶來約 350 億美元營收估算，光是 SpaceX 一家公司，就足以貢獻超過華爾街目前預估輝達 2027 年資料中心業務新增 1600 億美元營收的成長規模。
Caso 在報告中表示，「在市場擔憂 AI 支出能否持續之際，馬斯克這番談話提供了部分證據，顯示 AI 支出的成長動能可能仍將延續。」
他並指出，輝達與 OpenAI、Anthropic 及其他雲端服務供應商的合作案，使得「市場目前的預估數字顯得非常保守」。
馬斯克表示，SpaceX 新增的 AI 算力將用於開發 Grok 聊天機器人及 AI 軟體工具，同時將支援公司完成對 AI 程式設計平台 Cursor 的收購。
他並透露，SpaceX 打造的 Starmind AI 衛星，「本質上將是一台經改良的 Vera Rubin NVL72 電腦」，預計將於明年發射升空。Vera Rubin NVL72 為機櫃級系統，由 72 顆 Rubin GPU 及 36 顆 Vera CPU 組成。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) stock price surged on Wednesday, reversing a decline in the broader chip sector, marking its fifth consecutive day of gains.
During SpaceX's first earnings call, CEO Elon Musk heavily praised Nvidia's AI chips, which he said would be a key driver of the stock's price increase.
Musk called Nvidia's upcoming Vera Rubin chip architecture 'the best' and revealed that SpaceX has decided to adopt Nvidia's products in full.
He stated, 'We believe it's the best AI computer, and we're very grateful for our tight partnership with Nvidia across multiple levels.'

Later in the call, Musk further stated that SpaceX has reached an agreement with Nvidia to acquire a significant portion of its GPUs next year, with Nvidia currently dominating the GPU market and AMD (AMD-US) being its main competitor.
Nvidia's stock price rose 3.4% on Wednesday, marking its fifth consecutive day of gains, with a cumulative increase of 15.4% over this period.
SpaceX's computing expansion could be a major boost for Nvidia
Musk stated that SpaceX plans to build over 2GW of AI computing capacity by the end of the year and aims to increase it to nearly 10GW by the end of 2027.

Wolfe Research analyst Chris Caso noted that if Nvidia's each additional 1GW of deployed chips brings in approximately $35 billion in revenue, SpaceX alone could contribute more than the estimated $16 billion growth in Nvidia's data center business in 2027.
Caso stated in the report, 'In a market where concerns about AI spending persist, Musk's comments provide some evidence that AI spending growth may continue.'
He also pointed out that Nvidia's collaborations with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other cloud service providers make the current market estimates 'very conservative'.

Musk stated that SpaceX's new AI computing capacity will be used to develop the Grok chatbot and AI software tools, while also supporting the company's acquisition of the AI programming platform Cursor.

He also revealed that SpaceX's Starmind AI satellite will 'essentially be a modified Vera Rubin NVL72 computer', which is expected to be launched next year. The Vera Rubin NVL72 is a rack-level system composed of 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs.

items.title: 越跌越買！散戶投資者大舉抄底SpaceX 千億美元限售股將解禁
items.title_en: The More It Falls, the More It's Bought! Retail Investors Flock to Buy SpaceX Stocks as $100 Billion Lockup Expiration Looms
paras: AI 業務支出激增衝擊投資者情緒，太空探索公司 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 股價周三（5 日）收盤暴跌 13.61%，不過機構數據顯示，散戶投資者持續湧入 SpaceX 股票，開啟逢低抄底模式。
Vanda Research 的數據顯示，僅開盤第一個小時，個人交易者就淨買入 2,270 萬美元 SpaceX 股票；在 SpaceX 上市以來 37 個交易日當中，這一小時淨買入規模排在歷史第三名。
這代表 SpaceX 財報引發股價拋售後，散戶逢低買入的熱情並未消退，反而伺機而動。
SpaceX 上市創美國史上規模最大 IPO，發行價 135 美元，此後還從未出現過散戶淨賣出的交易日。
SpaceX 最新財報引發股價劇烈跳水。投資者擔憂，盈利的星鏈（Starlink）業務還能支撐高成本 AI 投資多久。
SpaceX 表示，第二季資本開支超過 180 億美元，較市場預期高出近 40%，這筆資金絕大部分用於建設資料中心以及其他 AI 相關支出。
AJ Bell 投資總監拉斯・穆爾德認為：「SpaceX 同行企業出現類似高額投入時，市場就已經表達過不滿。而本次 SpaceXAI 支出的規模，以及遠超分析師預期的幅度，是市場集體拋售的關鍵原因。星鏈是 SpaceX 目前唯一盈利的業務，發展態勢確實亮眼。但如果 SpaceX 想要股價回升，必須拿出一條更加確定的盈利路徑。」
SpaceX 周四將迎來另一樁足以攪動市場的事件 ——內部人士股份鎖定期到期，早期股東與內部員工持有的部分股份終於可以出售。
交易所的數據顯示，這些限制性股票鎖定期到期合計 9.115 億股，市值超過千億美元。這將使 SpaceX 自由流通股本擴大一倍以上。
值得注意的是，接下來的 8 月、9 月 SpaceX 還會有更多股份陸續解禁，解禁流程將持續至 12 月。這是美股歷史上規模最大的 IPO 後股份解禁之一。
paras_en: SpaceX's (SPCX-US) stock price plummeted 13.61% on Wednesday, but data shows retail investors continue to pour into the stock, triggering a 'buy the dip' pattern.
According to Vanda Research, retail traders bought $22.7 million worth of SpaceX stocks in the first hour of trading, ranking third in history among the 37 trading days since SpaceX's IPO.
This indicates that despite the sell-off triggered by SpaceX's earnings report, retail investors remain enthusiastic about buying the stock at lower prices.
SpaceX's IPO was the largest in US history, with a listing price of $135 per share, and has never seen a day of net selling by retail investors since its listing.
SpaceX's latest earnings report triggered a sharp stock price drop, with investors worried that the profitable Starlink business may not be able to sustain the high costs of AI investments for long.

SpaceX reported that its second-quarter capital expenditures exceeded $18 billion, surpassing market expectations by nearly 40%, with most of the funds going towards building data centers and other AI-related expenses.

AJ Bell's investment director, Russ Mold, believes that 'when rival companies make similar large investments, the market has already expressed its discontent. This time, the scale and magnitude of SpaceX's AI spending, far exceeding analysts' expectations, are the key reasons for the collective sell-off. Starlink is SpaceX's only profitable business, and its development prospects are indeed impressive. However, for SpaceX's stock price to recover, it must present a clearer path to profitability.'
On Thursday, SpaceX will face another market-moving event - the expiration of its internal lockup period, allowing early shareholders and employees to sell their shares for the first time.
Exchange data shows that the total number of restricted shares expiring is 911.5 million, with a market value exceeding $100 billion. This will significantly increase SpaceX's free float.
Notably, more shares will be released in August, September, and December, making this one of the largest IPOs in US history in terms of share lockup expiration.

items.title: 研究：AI並未搶走飯碗 但偷走了工資
paras: 《財富中文網》報導，人們對 AI 早已心生厭倦：厭倦了「AI 將奪走工作」論調，也厭倦了那些號稱最聰明的經濟學家至今無法解釋現狀。恰在此時，一個新理論應運而生，它能將所有線索巧妙地串聯在一起：AI 並未消滅工作崗位，而是在壓低工資。這也是員工們會奮起反抗的核心原因。
阿波羅全球管理公司一項新研究顯示，AI 技術帶來的最早可衡量的損害並非失業，而是薪資縮水。這項發現正值當前經濟學界爭論最激烈之際。即便是 AI 系統的開發者，也無法就其數據所傳達出的訊息達成一致。
一位經濟學家改變了看法
2026 年的大部分時間裡，阿波羅首席經濟學家斯洛克都在論證，AI 對勞動力市場的宏觀經濟影響幾乎無法量化預測。今年 4 月，他曾寫道：「AI 無處不在，唯獨不在即將公布的宏觀經濟數據中。」也就是說，無論從就業、生產率或通膨數據中，都找不到 AI 影響的直觀證據。

這位分析師因《每日火花》部落格以及此前在德意志銀行推出的「每日圖表」而聞名，他一直在預言一場「產業復興」，並預測 AI 將催生小微企業創業熱潮。5 月 29 日，他還在《每日火花》發表了一篇題為《沒有任何證據表明 AI 導致失業》的文章，斷言 AI 創造的就業崗位總量多於它摧毀的崗位數量。他還引用了自 4 月以來一直在推廣的「傑文斯悖論」，普及了「提高資源利用效率不會縮減勞動力，反而會擴大對該資源的總體需求」這觀點。Anthropic 執行長阿莫代伊隨後也開始使用這個術語，並順勢收回了此前對 AI 技術將造成大規模失業的預測。

7 月中旬，斯洛克公開表示，經濟學界在 AI 與就業關係上的解讀含糊其辭。他指出，關於 AI 對企業層面和就業層面的具體影響，「專家們根本無法達成共識」。7 月 30 日，斯洛克與薩尼婭 · 埃德利希聯合發表了一篇論文，試圖將各種相互矛盾的理論統一起來。區別於過去幾年 AI 勞動力研究中廣泛採用的理論性「暴露度」評分，研究團隊採用了 Anthropic 經濟指數中的實際使用數據，即 Claude 的真實互動紀錄，旨在衡量員工實際如何使用 AI，而非理論上能做什麼。他們發現的問題不是就業崗位流失，而是「薪資縮水」。
斯洛克寫道：「對 Claude 實際使用數據的分析顯示，在受 AI 影響較大的職業中，員工的工資增長速度正在放緩，但就業水準保持不變。這表明，企業正在透過壓低工資而非裁員，來獲取 AI 帶來的生產率提升。」這一結論也解釋了各行各業普遍出現抵制、甚至公然反對 AI 落地的現象。員工們似乎意識到，這些機器會讓他們的收入減少。
無論結論如何 員工都感受到了壓力
2026 年 6 月，Software Finder 對 1,005 名美國在職員工進行的一項獨立調查，捕捉到了這種脫離學術模型的現實焦慮。半數受訪員工表示會主動抗拒新的 AI 工具。
其中部分調查結果與斯洛克的論文存在一定矛盾：阿波羅的數據表明，無論員工是否採用 AI，受 AI 影響較大的職業薪資都受到壓縮；而 Software Finder 的調查則顯示，目前使用 AI 的員工收入高於抗拒 AI 的員工。這一差距很可能源於採用 AI 的人群本身的特徵（如管理人員、收入更高且工作穩定性更強的人更願意使用 AI），但不能證明使用 AI 本身能夠保護工資水準。
例如，Software Finder 的數據顯示，抗拒 AI 的員工平均年薪為 65,645 美元，比積極使用 AI 者的 81,526 美元低約 20%。45% 的受訪者因擔心被取代而對 AI 心存抵觸；只有 16% 的員工相信公司採用 AI 是出於真正的業務價值，而非跟風或迫於競爭壓力。
這兩種現象可以同時存在：根據斯洛克的研究，即便受 AI 影響的崗位工資水準逐漸走低，抗拒 AI 的員工仍可能遭遇薪資「打折」。AI 或許就是一台「薪資吞噬機」。
此外，職場中還普遍存在一種「AI 羞恥」現象：13% 的員工承認曾假裝使用 AI——看似在借助工具，實則在手動完成任務；只有 6% 的員工認為，管理者能準確掌握員工使用公司已部署 AI 工具的實際頻率。
《財富》雜誌的獨家報導顯示，這種抗拒情緒可能遠不只是默默回避，而會升級為蓄意破壞。2026 年 4 月，Writer 和 Workplace Intelligence 聯合對美國、英國和歐洲的 2,400 名知識型員工（含 1,200 名企業高管）進行了調查。

調查發現，29% 的員工承認曾主動破壞公司的 AI 戰略，而在 Z 世代員工中，這一比例更高達 44%。這種破壞行為形式多樣：將公司專有訊息輸入未經批准的公共 AI 工具；違規使用「影子 AI」系統；直接拒絕使用公司指定 AI 工具；部分員工甚至竄改績效評估數據或故意降低工作品質，以證明 AI 效果不佳。在承認實施過破壞行為的員工中，30% 表示其主要動機是擔心 AI 會頂替自己的工作，這與 Software Finder 調查中抗拒 AI 者的核心擔憂如出一轍。
數據揭示了什麼
阿波羅的這篇論文採用「雙重差分模型」，將 321 個職業與美國勞工統計局 2015 年至 2025 年的數據進行匹配分析。
研究發現，2023 年之後，高 AI 暴露職業的員工，其實際工資增長率比低暴露職業的員工放緩了 6.7 個百分點，但在統計學上並未對就業數據產生顯著影響。
這正是該研究論點的核心所在：AI 帶來的生產率提升是真實存在的，但這些收益流向了企業，而非員工手中。這結論也印證了《財富》雜誌 3 月份報導中提出的觀點：AI 壓縮了單項任務用時，意味著企業可以向員工派發更多工作任務。
這種影響主要集中在中低收入群體：

收入最低的四分之一人群：相較於低暴露職業，工資下降 10.7%；
第二四分位人群：工資下降 5.4%；
第三四分位人群：工資下降 4.0%；
收入最高的四分之一人群：無統計學層面顯著影響。高收入人群似乎更有能力消化 AI 帶來的衝擊，或從 AI 應用中獲益；
服務行業職業：工資下降 24.3%。但作者提醒，這結果基於較小樣本，因此需要謹慎解讀；
管理和專業崗位：工資下降 4.1%；
藍領崗位：沒有受到顯著影響。


目前，美國約 580 萬名員工（約占總勞動力的 3.7%）從事高 AI 暴露職業，持續感受到這種工資壓力。這意味著美國每年勞動收入損失保守估計達 280 億美元。論文作者預計，這一數字還將持續攀升。
Anthropic 經濟學家提出不同看法
讓情況更加複雜的是，斯洛克論文所依賴的底層數據，正是來自 Anthropic。而該公司的經濟學負責人彼得 · 麥克羅里於 7 月底在 X 平台發布長文，給出了截然不同的解讀。
基於 18 個月的內部研究，他得出的結論是：美國勞動力市場「尚未受到 AI 的明顯衝擊」。
麥克羅里指出，當前 4.2% 的失業率正處於聯準會認定的充分就業水準，職位空缺數與失業人數基本匹配，且黃金勞動年齡段（25-54 歲）就業率接近數十年來高點。
然而，麥克羅里和斯洛克的觀點並不存在本質對立，他們只是在用重疊的數據回答不同的問題。勞動力市場完全可能在失業率保持穩定的同時，悄然出現相對薪資下滑。但在「無就業危機」與「員工正遭受擠壓」兩個觀點被視為非此即彼的辯論中，其中的微妙差異極易被忽視。
這種混淆並非 Anthropic 獨有。今年 7 月，路透引用的一項綜合性文獻回顧發現，「大多數數據集並未發現整體經濟層面的就業減少或工資下降證據」，並將 AI 迄今的影響歸因於「任務重新分配與企業內部生產率提升，而非大規模替代」。這一結論與斯洛克關於「薪資縮水」的研究發現形成了明顯衝突。
一種更隱蔽、更難察覺的威脅
如果斯洛克的數據經得起檢驗，那麼 AI 壓低工資的效應並非打破傳統，而是契合了歷史規律。縱觀 20 世紀和 21 世紀，從農業機械化、工業自動化、電腦化，到離岸供應鏈，歷次技術革新浪潮無一不在降低生產成本的同時，壓低了受波及職業的薪資，儘管這些崗位整體而言仍推動了經濟產出的成長。
紡織機械化便是經典案例。它在創造更高薪的工廠職缺之前，就已重創手工織布工人的工資，並引發了 AI 時代經常被提及的「盧德運動」。百餘年後，20 世紀 80、90 年代工業機器人在製造業的應用，同樣伴隨著藍領工人實際工資長期停滯，儘管生產率持續穩步提升。「鐵鏽帶」（編者註：指美國五大湖周邊傳統工業衰退地區）的概念，正是在這樣的背景下誕生。
《金融時報》的喬爾．薩斯（Joel Suss）近期指出，自 1970 年前後開始，隨著勞動報酬占 GDP 比重相較於資本收益持續下滑，新技術帶來的收益便不再自動流向第一線勞工。他分析美國、日本及多數歐洲國家的數據後發現，這次情況並無不同。他指出：「如果 AI 的發展屬於一種偏向資本的技術變革，那麼薪資與生產率之間的落差將進一步擴大。」
綜合來看，一個無法被任何單一敘事完整解釋的勞動市場圖像正逐漸浮現——既不是阿莫代伊所警告的大規模裁員潮，也不是麥克羅里從失業數據中所看到的風平浪靜，而是一種更隱蔽、更具侵蝕性的影響：變化反映在薪資單上，而非解僱通知書裡。這種影響隱蔽到，即使兩位嚴謹的經濟學家觀察的是相近的數據，仍可能得出看似截然相反的結論。
這種不確定性，或許正是員工焦慮情緒普遍存在，卻又難以從總體經濟數據中獲得證實的原因。與此同時，即便斯洛克在論文中坦承研究仍有其侷限（AI 暴露度指標完全依賴 Anthropic 的數據，且在美國勞工統計局約 800 個職業分類中，僅成功匹配 321 個），他對於判斷失誤可能帶來的後果，態度依然十分明確：
「真正重要的政策問題，不在於 AI 是否終將更廣泛地重塑勞動市場，而在於這場變革將以多快的速度發生，以及當變革來臨時，勞工是否能獲得所需的支持。」

items.title: AI資料中心缺貨潮來了 諾基亞買下NXP工廠搶InP產能
items.title_en: AI Data Center Component Shortage Arrives as Nokia Buys NXP Plant to Capture InP Capacity
paras: 諾基亞（Nokia）加速布局 AI 資料中心基礎設施，宣布收購恩智浦（NXP）位於美國亞利桑那州錢德勒市的半導體工廠，計畫改造成磷化銦（InP）半導體生產線，提升光通訊元件自製能力。此舉顯示諾基亞正從傳統電信設備商轉型，搶攻 AI 時代資料中心高速光通訊需求。
隨著資料中心內部的通訊架構從傳統的銅線（Cu）迅速轉向光纖，能夠將電訊號與光訊號進行高效轉換的 InP 半導體已成為光通訊設備的關鍵核心元件。
然而，由於目前僅有少數如美商 Coherent 和 Lumentum 等晶圓廠具備生產能力，缺乏成熟的晶片代工（Foundry）生態系，導致市場長期面臨嚴重的供應短缺。
市場研究公司 Futurum 指出，受限於 InP 產能不足，當前光收發器的需求量已超過供應量的兩倍以上；Lumentum 執行長 Michael Hulston 更預警，InP 半導體的短缺程度未來恐將遠超越 DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體。
面對供應鏈瓶頸與客戶不斷湧入的光學設備訂單，諾基亞選擇跳脫單純的零件採購模式，直接收購並自主經營半導體工廠。
諾基亞執行長 Justin Hotard 表示，此次收購旨在確保額外的產能以滿足自身需求，同時在嚴峻的市場供應限制中為客戶保留更大的選擇空間。
根據規劃，諾基亞將自明年初開始透過租賃部分廠房進行 InP 量產，整體收購預計於 2029 年第一季正式完成。
事實上，這已非諾基亞首次透過併購深化光學與 AI 基礎設施布局。去年諾基亞便透過收購光學設備製造商 Infinera 獲得加州的 InP 晶圓廠及賓州的封裝後端工廠，目前正積極投資將該封裝廠的產能擴增 10 倍。
這一系列垂直整合策略已展現強勁成效，諾基亞今年第二季淨銷售額達 48.15 億歐元，年成長 9%，其中光通訊業務淨銷售額大增 20%，面向 AI 與雲端客戶的淨銷售額更高達 105% 的驚人成長，推動其紐約證交所股價今年以來已大幅上揚 52.4%。
《華爾街日報》引述分析指出，在曾任英特爾資料中心與人工智慧部門主管的 Hotard 領導下，諾基亞在北美光網絡市場的市占率，預計將從 2024 年的 6.3% 大幅躍升至 2025 年的 27.3%。
儘管部分市場觀察家如資本研究主管阿曼達 · 萊昂斯認為，諾基亞目前的估值已貼近純 AI 公司水準，未來仍需持續證明其獲利能力符合 AI 產業標準，但隨著錢德勒工廠的加入與 InP 產能的擴充，諾基亞已成功卡位 AI 資料中心基礎設施的核心關鍵地位。
paras_en: Nokia is accelerating its rollout of AI data‑center infrastructure, announcing the acquisition of NXP’s semiconductor fab in Chandler, Arizona, which it plans to convert into an indium phosphide (InP) production line to boost its in‑house optical‑communication component capability. The move shows Nokia shifting from a traditional telecom‑equipment vendor to a player targeting the high‑speed optical‑communication needs of AI‑era data centers.

As data‑center internal networking moves rapidly from copper wiring to fiber optics, InP semiconductors that efficiently convert electrical signals to optical ones have become a critical core component of optical‑communication equipment.

However, only a few wafer fabs such as Coherent and Lumentum in the United States currently have the capability to produce InP, and the lack of a mature foundry ecosystem has led to a long‑standing severe supply shortage in the market.

Market research firm Futurum notes that limited InP capacity has pushed demand for optical transceivers to more than twice the available supply; Lumentum CEO Michael Hulston warned that the shortage of InP chips could soon far exceed that of DRAM and NAND flash memory.

Facing supply‑chain bottlenecks and a flood of optical‑equipment orders from customers, Nokia chose to move beyond a pure component‑sourcing model and directly acquire and operate its own semiconductor plant.
Nokia CEO Justin Hotard said the purchase is intended to secure additional capacity to meet its own needs while giving customers a broader choice amid tight market supply constraints.
According to the plan, Nokia will begin leasing part of the facility for InP mass production early next year, with the overall acquisition slated to close in the first quarter of 2029.

In fact, this is not Nokia’s first time deepening its optical and AI infrastructure footprint through M&A. Last year, Nokia acquired optical‑equipment maker Infinera, gaining an InP wafer fab in California and a back‑end packaging plant in Pennsylvania, and is now actively investing to expand the packaging plant’s capacity tenfold.

These vertical‑integration moves have already shown strong results: Nokia’s Q2 net sales reached €4.815 billion, up 9% year‑on‑year, with optical‑communication sales jumping 20% and AI‑ and cloud‑customer sales soaring 105%, driving its NYSE share price up 52.4% so far this year.

The Wall Street Journal, citing analysts, noted that under Hotard—formerly head of Intel’s data‑center and AI division—Nokia’s market share in North American optical networking is expected to leap from 6.3% in 2024 to 27.3% in 2025.

Although some market observers such as Capital Research head Amanda Lyons argue that Nokia’s current valuation is already close to that of pure‑play AI firms and that it must still prove its profitability meets AI‑industry standards, the addition of the Chandler plant and expanded InP capacity have positioned Nokia firmly in the core infrastructure of AI data centers.

items.title: 貝佐斯今年來首次減持亞馬遜股票 套現3.5億美元
items.title_en: Bezos Sells Amazon Stock for First Time This Year, Cashes Out $350 Million
paras: 美國電商巨擘亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 股價周一（3 日）創紀錄新高之際，創辦人貝佐斯出售價值近 3.5 億美元的亞馬遜股票，這是他今年來首次出售亞馬遜股份。
據《彭博》周四報導，美股周三盤後發布的 Form 4 申報文件中披露了這筆交易。這位億萬富豪兩天前在另一份文件中表示，計畫出售最多 1,500 萬股亞馬遜股票，價值超過 40 億美元，此次出售僅占該計畫一小部分。
今年來亞馬遜股價勁漲 18%，貝佐斯的財富增加了 387 億美元，達到 2,920 億美元。亞馬遜上周公布雲端運算業務營收表現強勁後，成為全球第五家市值突破 3 兆美元的公司。
貝佐斯此次售股後，仍以 8.16% 的持股比例遙遙領先，是亞馬遜最大股東。
貝佐斯近年來加快出售亞馬遜股票。自 2020 年以來，他便出售了價值超過 380 億美元的股份。相比之下，從亞馬遜 1997 年首次公開募股到 2020 年之前，他累計出售的股票不到 100 億美元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. e‑commerce giant Amazon (AMZN‑US) saw its share price hit a record high on Monday (the 3rd), and founder Jeff Bezos sold Amazon stock worth nearly $350 million, marking his first sale of Amazon shares this year.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday, a Form 4 filing released after market close on Wednesday disclosed the transaction. The billionaire had indicated two days earlier in another filing that he planned to sell up to 15 million Amazon shares, valued at over $4 billion, and this sale represents only a small portion of that plan.

Amazon’s stock has surged 18% so far this year, boosting Bezos’s wealth by $38.7 billion to $292 billion. After Amazon reported strong cloud‑computing revenue last week, it became the world’s fifth company with a market value exceeding $3 trillion.
After this sale, Bezos still holds an 8.16% stake, remaining far ahead as Amazon’s largest shareholder.

Bezos has accelerated his Amazon stock sales in recent years. Since 2020 he has sold shares worth more than $38 billion. By contrast, from Amazon’s IPO in 1997 up to 2020 he sold less than $10 billion worth of stock.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication.)

items.title: 三星4奈米產能爆滿至明年 強推5奈米迎中印轉單潮
paras: 隨著半導體市場需求結構轉變，三星電子 (005930KS) 晶圓代工業務正加速調整產能布局。業界消息指出，因 4 奈米製程產能接近滿載，三星積極推廣成熟且具成本優勢的 5 奈米製程，吸引國內外無晶圓廠（Fabless）客戶採用，開拓新一波代工商機。
根據半導體產業透露的消息，三星晶圓代工的 4 奈米製程產能預計將持續維持滿載狀態至明年。業內人士指出，這波 4 奈米生產線的高利用率，主要歸功於三星電子內部高頻寬記憶體（HBM4）訂單的激增，使得記憶體部門躍升為該代工廠最大的客戶群。
此外，輝達 (NVDA-US) （NVIDIA）推理語言處理單元（LPU）「GROK-3」的產量超越預期，也進一步推高了 4 奈米製程的產能負荷。
面對 4 奈米產線飽和的現狀，三星晶圓代工順勢調整策略，將 5 奈米製程定位為關鍵的替代方案。
對於考量到 2 奈米或 3 奈米先進工藝成本高昂、且在良率上面臨沈重負擔的無晶圓廠客戶而言，已經具備高度成熟良率與優異性能的 5 奈米製程，成為兼顧效能與成本的最佳選擇。
傳統上，5 奈米製程多被視為專為車用領域設計的生產線。例如，現代汽車計劃於 2030 年前量產的高級駕駛輔助系統（ADAS）晶片、Bose 半導體的 SoC，以及 Telechips 的車用 AP Dolphin 7 晶片，皆規劃採用專屬車用 SF5A 製程進行量產。
然而，隨著市場需求演進，其應用範圍已迅速擴大至伺服器、高效能人工智慧及神經網路處理單元（NPU）晶片。
另一位半導體業內人士解釋，由於 5 奈米製程同樣適用於高性能伺服器晶片的製造，海外無晶圓廠公司的授權協議持續簽署，近三、四個月以來，客戶對 5 奈米製程的需求顯著增加。
除此之外，全球地緣政治因素以及競爭對手台積電先進生產線的供需趨緊，也為三星帶來了間接利多。
隨著台積電在 3 奈米、4 奈米及 5 奈米產能上呈現吃緊態勢，中國與印度的無晶圓廠業者紛紛將目光轉向三星的 5 奈米產線，藉此滿足先進製程需求並規避相關制裁。
業界合作夥伴指出，對於在美國對華制裁下尋求先進製程性能的中國與印度客戶而言，三星晶圓代工提供了一個務實的解決方案，並成功吸納了被台積電擠出的中小規模客戶訂單。
另一方面，儘管 5 奈米製程成為當前推廣與實際銷售的核心，全球客戶對於 2 奈米製程的探詢與諮詢也未曾間斷。
業內人士強調，三星晶圓廠仍持續進行 2nm 製程的相關交流，而未來能否突破的關鍵，仍在於確保穩定的量產良率。

items.title: 占比衝35%！南韓每賣3輛EV就有1輛中國製 來自上海超級工廠的特斯拉是主力
paras: 最新數據顯示，今年上半年在南韓銷售的電動車中，中國製造的汽車首次超過三分之一。
《韓聯社》報導，南韓汽車移動產業協會周二 (4 日) 發布分析報告指出，今年 1-6 月，在該國新登記的中國製造電動車接近 7 萬輛，年增 178.7%，在整體新登記的電動車中佔比升至 35%。
該協會表示，中國產電動車大量湧入南韓有助於推動電動車普及、拓寬消費者選項，但同時可能加大本土車廠經營壓力，加劇產業鏈競爭。
報導指出，中國產電動車在南韓車市銷量大幅成長，大部分來自特斯拉上海超級工廠生產的 Model Y 和 Model 3。
根據韓國進口車協會 (KAIDA) 統計，今年上半年，南韓新註冊進口乘用車數量為 18.4 萬輛，特斯拉以 5.61 萬輛居首，佔乘用車進口總量的 30.5%。而相關數據顯示，約 97% 南韓特斯拉進口車輛產自中國。
特斯拉上海工廠是全球電動車供應鏈的重要樞紐，該車廠零件本地化率超過 95%，年產能超過 95 萬輛，並承擔歐洲和亞太市場出口任務。
特斯拉上海工廠 7 月批發銷量達 9.3579 萬輛，年增 37.8%，季增 5%，創今年單月新高。
此外，極星等國際品牌的部分車型也在中國生產，再出口至韓國。
與此同時，中國自主品牌也開始在南韓車市建立存在感。比亞迪去年正式進軍當地，今年前 5 月註冊量達 7023 輛，在南韓進口乘用車品牌中排名第四，僅次於特斯拉、BMW 和賓士。

items.title: 伊朗總統：目前很難與最高領袖穆吉塔巴聯繫
items.title_en: Iran President: Currently Difficult to Contact Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei
paras: 伊朗總統裴澤斯基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 週三 (6 日) 表示，目前與最高領袖穆吉塔巴 · 哈米尼 (Mojtaba Khamenei) 保持聯繫「非常困難」，但強調對方依然是伊朗的重要精神支柱，在國家面臨外部壓力之際具有關鍵凝聚作用。
裴澤斯基安是在就職兩週年接受伊朗國營電視台專訪時作出上述表示。裴澤斯基安表示：「目前要與他 (穆吉塔巴) 聯繫非常困難，但無論如何，他的存在對我們而言都是極大的精神支柱，讓我們得以繼續前進。」
他指出，政府官員越能坦率向最高領袖說明問題，彼此就越容易建立共識並形成一致決策。
談及穆吉塔巴時，裴澤斯基安形容他是一位「非凡的人物」，並表示自己對其品格、謙遜態度及理性判斷留下深刻印象。
針對近期國內輿論，裴澤斯基安批評，有人藉由最高領袖對美伊合作備忘錄的立場刻意製造內部分裂。他指出，穆吉塔巴最終公開支持這項協議，儘管一開始曾抱持保留態度。
這份共 14 點的美伊合作備忘錄於 2026 年 6 月 17 日，由美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 與裴澤斯基安簽署，內容包括正式停火、解除海上封鎖及停止雙方軍事行動，目的在為後續和平談判建立框架。
裴澤斯基安表示，伊朗目前正承受來自外部日益升高的壓力，包括制裁與軍事對抗，對手試圖藉此激化民眾不滿情緒，甚至鼓動示威抗議。他形容，這是自 1979 年伊斯蘭革命以來，伊朗面臨最艱難的時期。
穆吉塔巴於今年 3 月 8 日接任伊朗最高領袖，其父親、前最高領袖阿里 · 哈米尼 (Ali Khamenei) 於 2 月 28 日在德黑蘭遭美國與以色列聯合空襲身亡。
伊朗領導層交接期間，美伊軍事衝突持續升溫。伊朗曾以飛彈及無人機攻擊駐有美軍基地的波灣國家作為報復，雙方隨後於 4 月達成停火，並在巴基斯坦斡旋下於 6 月簽署合作備忘錄，盼為終結衝突與推動長期和平奠定基礎。
不過，這項協議於上月破裂，美伊再度爆發近兩週的軍事衝突，直到傳出雙方重新展開談判後，川普才下令停止空襲，使戰事暫時降溫。
paras_en: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated on Wednesday (6th) that it is currently 'very difficult' to maintain contact with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, but emphasized that he remains an important spiritual pillar for Iran, playing a crucial role in uniting the nation in the face of external pressure.

Pezeshkian made the statement during an interview with Iran's state-run television on the occasion of his two-year presidency. He said, 'It is very difficult to contact him (Mojtaba) now, but regardless, his presence is a huge spiritual pillar for us, allowing us to continue moving forward.'
He pointed out that government officials are more likely to establish consensus and make unified decisions when they are honest with the Supreme Leader about the problems they face.
When discussing Mojtaba, Pezeshkian described him as an 'extraordinary person' and expressed his deep impression of Mojtaba's character, humility, and rational judgment.

In response to recent domestic opinion, Pezeshkian criticized some people for intentionally creating internal divisions by taking advantage of the Supreme Leader's stance on the US-Iran cooperation memorandum. He noted that Mojtaba ultimately publicly supported the agreement, despite initially having reservations.

The 14-point US-Iran cooperation memorandum, signed on June 17, 2026, by US President Donald Trump and Pezeshkian, includes formal ceasefire, lifting of naval blockade, and cessation of military actions, with the aim of establishing a framework for future peace talks.

Pezeshkian stated that Iran is currently facing increasing external pressure, including sanctions and military confrontation, with opponents trying to fuel public discontent and even incite protests. He described this as the most difficult period Iran has faced since the 1979 Islamic Revolution.

Mojtaba took over as Iran's Supreme Leader on March 8 this year, following the death of his father, former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, who was killed in a joint US-Israeli airstrike in Tehran on February 28.

During the transition of power in Iran, the military conflict between the US and Iran escalated. Iran had retaliated by launching missiles and drones at US military bases in Gulf countries, followed by a ceasefire in April and the signing of the cooperation memorandum in June, facilitated by Pakistan, in the hope of establishing a foundation for ending the conflict and promoting long-term peace.

However, the agreement broke down last month, leading to a near two-week military conflict between the US and Iran, which only subsided after Trump ordered a halt to airstrikes following reports of renewed negotiations.

items.title: Yardeni：AI交易進入成果導向時代 市場不再為題材埋單
items.title_en: Yardeni: AI Trading Enters Outcome-Oriented Era, Market No Longer Blindly Buys Hyperscalers
paras: Yardeni Research 最新報告指出，投資人已不再像 AI 浪潮初期一樣，對大型雲端服務商 (Hyperscalers) 的 AI 布局照單全收，而是開始依據各家公司實際的資本支出、已簽約訂單及雲端業務成長表現，重新評估投資價值。
AI 投資熱潮正在進入新階段，最新報告指出，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 四大雲端業者 2026 會計年度合計資本支出預計約達 6,000 億美元，較 2025 會計年度的 3,090 億美元大幅增加。
受到電力供應、設備交付及地方政府許可等因素影響，不少資料中心建設時程已延後至 2027 年甚至更晚，但 Yardeni 認為，這代表的是建設時程遞延，而非企業縮減 AI 投資。
Yardeni 引用研究機構 Sightline Climate 的統計指出，目前追蹤的 777 個大型資料中心計畫中，真正取消的僅有 9 個，顯示 AI 基礎建設投資仍持續推進，整體需求並未出現明顯退潮。
除了持續擴大資本支出之外，四大雲端業者手中也握有龐大的未履約合約 (RPO)。
截至 2026 會計年度，四家公司合計未履約合約規模已超過 2.3 兆美元，其中微軟約 6,780 億美元居冠，甲骨文則約 6,380 億美元，代表未來仍有大量已簽約、尚未認列的收入可望逐步實現。
不過，Yardeni 也提醒，市場仍須留意客戶集中風險，尤其 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 是否能如期履行龐大的算力採購承諾。
標普全球評級 (S&P Global Ratings) 今年 7 月便以甲骨文對 OpenAI 依賴程度較高為由，將其信用評等調降至 BBB-，反映市場對相關風險的擔憂。
報告也指出，AI 基礎建設的資金來源正出現變化。
過去大型雲端業者多仰賴自身營運現金流支應資本支出，但隨著投資規模快速擴大，自由現金流已不足以完全支撐。
Alphabet 於 2026 年第二季首次出現單季自由現金流轉負，亞馬遜截至 6 月底的近 12 個月自由現金流亦轉為流出 76 億美元。
根據高盛估算，2025 年大型雲端業者約有 26% 的資本支出透過外部融資 (主要為舉債) 支應，預估 2026 年將升至 33%，2027 年則可能進一步提高至約 35%，顯示 AI 投資更加地依賴外部資金。
儘管投入成本持續增加，各家雲端業務仍維持強勁成長。微軟 Cloud 2026 會計年度營收達 2,143 億美元，年增 27%；AWS 截至 6 月底近四季累計營收 1,347 億美元，年增 50%；Google Cloud 營收 777 億美元，年增 60%；Oracle Cloud 營收 340 億美元，年增 39%。
Yardeni 表示，市場如今已不再將大型雲端業者視為同一投資族群，而是根據各家公司 AI 投資策略、未履約訂單規模及實際雲端營收表現逐一評價。
以今年股價表現來看，甲骨文因自由現金流惡化及對 OpenAI 高度依賴的疑慮，今年以來股價仍下跌 28%；微軟則在雲端業績優於預期後收復部分跌幅；Alphabet 今年累計上漲 20%，亞馬遜在 AWS 財報帶動下，今年以來亦上漲約 18%。
Yardeni 總結指出，AI 投資主軸已經發生根本轉變，市場不再僅憑對 AI 前景的期待給予高估值，而是更加重視企業是否真正展現出營收成長、訂單能見度以及資本投入所帶來的實際成果。
paras_en: Yardeni Research's latest report indicates that investors are no longer blindly following the AI wave, as they did in its early stages, and are instead reassessing investment values based on actual capital expenditures, signed contracts, and cloud business growth.

The AI investment frenzy is entering a new phase, with the report indicating that Amazon (AMZN-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), and Oracle (ORCL-US) will collectively spend around $600 billion on capital expenditures in 2026, a significant increase from $309 billion in 2025.

Despite delays in data center construction due to factors such as power supply, equipment delivery, and local government permits, Yardeni believes this represents a delay in construction schedules rather than a reduction in AI investment.

According to Sightline Climate, a research institution, only 9 out of 777 large data center projects have been canceled, indicating that AI infrastructure investment continues to push forward, with no significant decline in demand.
In addition to increasing capital expenditures, the four major cloud providers also have massive unpaid contracts (RPOs) in hand.

As of 2026, the total value of unpaid contracts for the four companies exceeds $2.3 trillion, with Microsoft leading the pack at around $678 billion, followed by Oracle at around $638 billion, indicating a large amount of future revenue that will be gradually realized.

However, Yardeni also warns that market participants should be cautious of customer concentration risks, particularly with OpenAI and Anthropic's ability to fulfill their massive computing power procurement commitments.
In July, S&P Global Ratings downgraded Oracle's credit rating to BBB- due to its high dependence on OpenAI, reflecting market concerns about related risks.
The report also notes that the funding sources for AI infrastructure are changing.

In the past, large cloud providers relied heavily on their own operating cash flows to fund capital expenditures, but as investment scales rapidly, free cash flow is no longer sufficient to fully support it.
Alphabet reported a negative free cash flow in the second quarter of 2026, and Amazon's free cash flow turned negative in the 12 months ending June 30, totaling $76 billion.

According to Goldman Sachs estimates, in 2025, large cloud providers relied on external financing (mainly debt) for around 26% of their capital expenditures, which is expected to rise to 33% in 2026 and potentially reach around 35% in 2027, indicating that AI investment is becoming increasingly dependent on external funding.

Despite increasing costs, cloud businesses continue to maintain strong growth. Microsoft Cloud's revenue reached $214 billion in 2026, a 27% increase year-over-year; AWS reported $134.7 billion in revenue over the past four quarters, a 50% increase year-over-year; Google Cloud's revenue reached $77.7 billion, a 60% increase year-over-year; and Oracle Cloud's revenue reached $34 billion, a 39% increase year-over-year.

Yardeni notes that the market is no longer viewing large cloud providers as a single investment group, but rather evaluating each company based on its AI investment strategy, unpaid contract size, and actual cloud revenue performance.

Looking at this year's stock performance, Oracle's stock has fallen 28% due to concerns about its free cash flow and high dependence on OpenAI, while Microsoft has recovered some of its losses after its cloud business exceeded expectations; Alphabet's stock has risen 20% this year, and Amazon's stock has risen around 18% this year, driven by AWS's strong earnings.

Yardeni concludes that the main axis of AI investment has undergone a fundamental shift, with the market no longer relying solely on expectations of AI's future prospects to assign high valuations, but rather focusing on whether companies are actually demonstrating revenue growth, order visibility, and the actual results of capital investment.

items.title: 輝達急尋中國AI基地台供應商 明後年啟動端側算力組網
items.title_en: Nvidia Urgently Seeking Chinese AI Base Station Supplier, Plans Edge Computing Network Launch in Next One to Two Years
paras: 美國晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 正在中國急尋 AI 基地台供應商，開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台（既負責通訊連接，又能承擔 AI 運算的基地台）。
通訊產業鏈核心人士透露，輝達正在加速進入電信市場，並在中國尋找基地台廠商合作方，開發符合海外市場要求的 6G 基地台。
據《界面新聞》6 日（周四）報導，該人士形容，輝達在找端側算力的「下一個中際旭創」，因為輝達認為，算力接下來要從資料中心傳輸到海量的 AI 終端和用戶，最終需要依賴基地台的無線傳輸。
上述人士稱，輝達推動這一項目的節奏「比較緊迫」，希望在 2027 或 2028 年進入試驗網。
據《界面新聞》報導，深圳佳賢通信是輝達正在建立的基地台合作方之一，其內部人士證實，輝達從 2025 年就與公司接觸，雙方正基於輝達 CUDA 生態合作開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台，雙方合作已持續半年多。
「佳賢通信和輝達已經組建了專門工作組。輝達方面有十餘人參與其中，成員分布在新加坡、香港及中國內地。目前工作組正圍繞輝達 CUDA 系統的開源生態進行研究。」佳賢通信相關人士說。
佳賢通信成立於 2011 年，總部位於深圳，是一家 AI-RAN 無線通訊產品及解決方案提供商。
據《界面新聞》報導，佳賢通信與輝達的合作進入技術研發階段，不排除成立商業主體，聯合進行海外拓展。
「首先在技術層面，我們已經開始合作。」佳賢通信相關人士表示，目前在雙方的合作中，輝達並不直接生產和銷售完整基地台，而是以晶片和技術生態的方式參與，即基地台公司採購輝達 GPU，並基於輝達 CUDA 生態開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台，完成產品後，再向海外市場銷售。
「預計今年年底跟輝達開發的 AI 基地台樣機就會出來，在驗證通過後，一兩年內就會推向市場。」上述人士說。
對輝達來說，AI 基地台是一門不亞於算力資料中心的好生意。
AI 1.0 階段，算力主要集中在資料中心，輝達銷售大量 GPU；AI 應用落地 2.0 階段，端側算力應用空間更為廣闊，輝達希望邊緣和端側算力也採用其晶片，因此布局 AI 基地台，是輝達為即將到來的端側算力做準備。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US), the U.S. chip giant, is urgently looking for AI base station suppliers in China to develop 6G AI‑RAN base stations that handle both communications connectivity and AI computing.

Industry insiders in the telecom supply chain say Nvidia is accelerating its entry into the telecom market and is seeking Chinese base‑station partners to develop 6G stations that meet overseas market requirements.

According to a report by Jiemian News on Thursday the 6th, the source described Nvidia as searching for the “next Zhongji Xuchuang” for edge computing, because Nvidia believes future compute will shift from data centers to massive AI endpoints and users, ultimately relying on wireless transmission via base stations.
The source said Nvidia’s pace for this project is “quite urgent,” hoping to enter a trial network in 2027 or 2028.

Jiemian News reported that Shenzhen Jiashen Communications is one of the base‑station partners Nvidia is establishing; an insider confirmed Nvidia has been in contact with the company since 2025 and the two have been co‑developing a 6G AI‑RAN base station based on Nvidia’s CUDA ecosystem for over half a year.

“Jiashen Communications and Nvidia have formed a dedicated working group. More than ten Nvidia staff are involved, located in Singapore, Hong Kong and mainland China. The group is currently researching around Nvidia’s open‑source CUDA ecosystem,” said a Jiashen Communications representative.
Jiashen Communications was founded in 2011, is headquartered in Shenzhen, and provides AI‑RAN wireless communication products and solutions.
Jiemian News said the cooperation between Jiashen Communications and Nvidia has entered the technical R&D stage, and a commercial entity may be formed to jointly pursue overseas expansion.

“On the technical side, we have already started cooperating,” said the Jiashen representative. Currently Nvidia does not directly manufacture or sell complete base stations; instead it participates through chips and its technology ecosystem, with the base‑station maker purchasing Nvidia GPUs and developing 6G AI‑RAN stations on the CUDA platform, then selling the finished products overseas.
“We expect a prototype AI base station developed with Nvidia to be ready by the end of this year; after validation, it should reach the market within one to two years,” the source added.
For Nvidia, AI base stations represent a business as significant as data‑center compute.

In the AI 1.0 era, compute was concentrated in data centers and Nvidia sold large volumes of GPUs; in the AI 2.0 era, edge and endpoint compute opportunities are far broader, and Nvidia wants its chips to be used there as well, so its push into AI base stations is preparation for the upcoming wave of edge computing.

items.title: 2026年晶片預測：銷量暴增98.3% 直逼1.7兆美元
items.title_en: 2026 Chip Forecast: Sales to Surge 98.3% to Nearly $1.7 Trillion
paras: 半導體產業正步入一個非凡的成長階段，其主要驅動力是 AI 基礎設施，以及先進邏輯與記憶體元件供應的嚴重瓶頸。根據《麥克林報告》（McClean Report）2026 年 6 月更新版，全球半導體市場預計將在 2026 年成長 98.3%，達到約 1.7 兆美元，並在 2027 年進一步擴張至超過 2.2 兆美元。
這並非正常的週期性復甦，而是反映出 AI 資料中心快速建設所帶動的市場需求結構性轉變。在這些資料中心中，GPU、高頻寬記憶體（HBM）、先進 DRAM、NAND 快閃記憶體、先進晶圓代工產能以及先進封裝技術，都已成為供應瓶頸。
從技術角度來看，最重要的驅動因素是記憶體。報告預測，到 2026 年，記憶體市場規模將成長 298%，達到 9,164 億美元。這一成長主要由價格帶動：記憶體出貨量預計僅增加 8%，但平均售價預計將上漲 268%。
這種差距至關重要，代表業界並非只是賣出更多晶片，而是以更高的價格出售稀缺且具有戰略價值的晶片。
HBM 正是這波成長的核心，因為 AI 加速器需要極高的記憶體頻寬，才能在訓練與推論期間，持續為 GPU 提供大量資料。HBM 採用垂直堆疊記憶體，並透過先進封裝技術連接，因此可提供遠高於傳統記憶體架構的頻寬。
然而，HBM 的崛起也帶來產能取捨。報告指出，相同容量的 HBM 所需晶圓面積約為標準 DDR5 的三倍，製造成本也約為其四倍。隨著三星、SK 海力士及美光等業者將更多晶圓產能轉向 HBM，主流 DRAM 供應也隨之趨緊。
這不僅推升 HBM 價格，也帶動 PC、伺服器、智慧型手機、汽車系統及工業電子所使用的非 HBM DRAM 價格同步上漲。這也意味著，AI 需求正影響整體科技供應鏈，而不只是 AI 硬體供應商。
邏輯晶片同樣受惠於這波趨勢。MOS 邏輯市場預計到 2026 年將成長 32%，達到 5,775 億美元，其中 GPU 將成為主要成長引擎。GPU 營收預計於 2026 年成長 31%，主要受惠於出貨量增加及平均售價提高。
這些 GPU 是 AI 資料中心的運算核心，透過平行運算執行 Transformer 模型訓練、推論、模擬，以及機器人、汽車、醫療保健等領域日益普及的實體 AI（Physical AI）應用。
此外，微處理器（MPU）與微控制器（MCU）也預計恢復成長，受惠於作業系統升級、工業需求回溫，以及汽車市場持續穩健。
這之所以重要，是因為半導體產業正從單純的零組件產業，逐步轉變為具有戰略地位的核心產業。
如今，晶片已決定人工智慧部署、雲端運算擴張、自主系統、機器人、醫療設備、智慧基礎設施及先進消費性電子產品的發展速度。
如果到了 2027 年，先進晶圓產能、高頻寬記憶體供應、光刻設備及先進封裝技術仍持續受限，擁有穩定供應協議的企業將具備顯著競爭優勢。相反地，依賴現貨市場採購或仰賴通用記憶體的企業，可能面臨更高成本、更長交期，以及產品延後上市等挑戰。
報告也提出一項值得關注的問題：這究竟只是短暫的超級週期，還是永久性的結構性變革？
歷史上，半導體產業每次景氣繁榮，往往最終都因供應商過度擴產，導致供給過剩及價格崩跌。《麥克林報告》也坦言，2028 年至 2029 年間仍存在這項風險。
不過，報告同時指出，人工智慧可能代表一個更持久的需求來源。如果 AI 推論工作負載持續擴展至消費市場、企業、工業及邊緣運算領域，即使新增產能陸續開出，半導體需求仍可能維持高檔。
實際上，半導體市場已不再只是圍繞個人電腦與智慧型手機的景氣循環，而是愈來愈聚焦於全球人工智慧基礎設施建設的競賽。
這也使得記憶體頻寬、GPU 供應能力、先進封裝，以及領先製程能力，成為衡量未來科技發展、企業競爭力與經濟成長的重要指標。
paras_en: The semiconductor industry is entering an extraordinary growth phase, driven primarily by AI infrastructure and the severe shortage of advanced logic and memory components. According to the McClean Report updated in June 2026, the global semiconductor market is expected to grow by 98.3% in 2026, reaching approximately $1.7 trillion, and further expand to over $2.2 trillion in 2027.

This is not a normal cyclical recovery, but rather a reflection of the structural change in market demand driven by the rapid construction of AI data centers. In these data centers, GPUs, high-bandwidth memory (HBM), advanced DRAM, NAND flash memory, advanced wafer production capacity, and advanced packaging technologies have become supply bottlenecks.

From a technical perspective, the most important driver is memory. The report predicts that the memory market will grow by 298% by 2026, reaching $916.4 billion. This growth is mainly driven by price: memory shipments are expected to increase by only 8%, but the average selling price is expected to rise by 268%.
This gap is crucial, representing that the industry is not just selling more chips, but selling scarce and strategically valuable chips at a higher price.

HBM is at the core of this growth, as AI accelerators require extremely high memory bandwidth to continuously provide large amounts of data to GPUs during training and inference. HBM uses vertically stacked memory and connects through advanced packaging technology, providing much higher bandwidth than traditional memory architectures.

However, the rise of HBM also brings production trade-offs. The report points out that the same capacity of HBM requires about three times the wafer area of standard DDR5 and costs about four times as much to produce. As manufacturers such as Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron allocate more wafer production capacity to HBM, mainstream DRAM supply is also becoming tighter.

This not only drives up HBM prices but also pushes up the prices of non-HBM DRAM used in PCs, servers, smartphones, automotive systems, and industrial electronics. This means that AI demand is affecting the entire tech supply chain, not just AI hardware suppliers.

Logic chips are also benefiting from this trend. The MOS logic market is expected to grow by 32% by 2026, reaching $57.75 billion, with GPUs becoming the main growth engine. GPU revenue is expected to grow by 31% in 2026, mainly driven by increased shipments and higher average prices.

These GPUs are the computing core of AI data centers, executing Transformer model training, inference, simulation, and physical AI applications in areas such as robotics, automotive, healthcare, and more, through parallel computing.
Additionally, microprocessors (MPUs) and microcontrollers (MCUs) are also expected to recover, driven by operating system upgrades, industrial demand, and a stable automotive market.
This is important because the semiconductor industry is transitioning from a simple component industry to a strategically positioned core industry.
Today, chips determine the development speed of AI deployment, cloud computing expansion, autonomous systems, robotics, medical devices, smart infrastructure, and advanced consumer electronics.

If advanced wafer production capacity, high-bandwidth memory supply, lithography equipment, and advanced packaging technologies remain constrained by 2027, companies with stable supply agreements will have a significant competitive advantage. In contrast, companies relying on spot market purchases or general memory may face higher costs, longer lead times, and delayed product launches.
The report also raises a question worth noting: is this just a short-term super cycle or a permanent structural change?

Historically, every semiconductor industry boom has eventually ended due to suppliers over-expanding, leading to oversupply and price crashes. The McClean Report also acknowledges that this risk still exists between 2028 and 2029.

However, the report also points out that artificial intelligence may represent a more sustainable source of demand. If AI inference workloads continue to expand into consumer, enterprise, industrial, and edge computing markets, even with new production capacity coming online, semiconductor demand may remain high.
In fact, the semiconductor market is no longer just about the PC and smartphone cycles, but is increasingly focused on the global competition for AI infrastructure construction.

This also makes memory bandwidth, GPU supply capability, advanced packaging, and leading-edge process capabilities important indicators for measuring future technological development, corporate competitiveness, and economic growth.

paras: 美元周三 (5 日) 走弱，跌至七周低點，市場期待華府與德黑蘭朝達成和平協議邁進。同時，日元走勢震盪，但仍遠高於上周美日聯手干預匯市前創下的 40 年低點。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 0.2%，報 99.68，創 6 月 16 日以來最低水準。
外匯市場焦點仍是日元。日元兌美元小幅走強，美元兌日元最新報 157.69，微幅下跌。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 本周稍早證實，美國已與日本共同進場買入日元，這是 2011 年以來雙方首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首度直接出手支撐日元。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助干預，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能對亞洲金融市場造成衝擊。
德意志銀行策略師 Jim Reid 表示，「我們的外匯策略團隊認為，日本央行 (BoJ) 必須加快升息步伐，才能讓日元出現更持久的回升。」
日本央行周三公布最新利率會議紀錄顯示，決策官員預期，中東衝突引發的油價衝擊，可能導致日本經濟成長放緩，同時推升通膨。
Reid 指出，「日本央行 6 月會議紀錄顯示，多位委員預期，本會計年度下半年消費者通膨將明顯升溫，八位委員中有兩位主張加快升息步伐。最新公布的日本薪資數據，也可能持續增加央行升息的壓力。」
經濟數據偏弱 美元續承壓
美國經濟數據也是市場焦點。根據 ADP，美國 7 月民間新增就業人數為 4.4 萬人，低於市場預估的 6.8 萬人，也較 6 月新增的 9.5 萬人放緩。
這項數據延續了周二公布的 6 月職缺數據所反映的降溫趨勢，也為周五將公布的 7 月非農就業報告提供參考。
儘管本周公布的勞動市場數據偏弱，但整體就業市場仍展現韌性，也支持聯準會 (Fed) 近期將政策重心重新放在控制通膨。
中東衝突導致油價波動，擾亂通膨走勢，也使聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
此外，美國供應管理協會 (ISM) 公布，7 月服務業 PMI 由 6 月的 54 升至 54.1，但略低於市場預估的 54.5。其中，衡量服務業企業支付原物料及投入成本變化的物價指數較 6 月進一步攀升，且近五個月已有四次高於 70，顯示成本壓力仍高。
市場期待荷姆茲海峽協議即將達成
中東局勢方面，包括美國總統川普在內，多位美國官員表示，重新開放荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 的重要協議已接近完成。
川普周二晚間向媒體表示，「事情進展得非常順利。我想 48 小時內就會知道結果。」
他並談到，「我們取得了很大進展。他們打電話給我說『拜託，我們談談吧。』他們希望展開對話。有趣的是，他們從來不提這件事…… 我認為，達成協議對他們來說會是非常明智的選擇。我們拭目以待。」
伊朗外交部則表示，德黑蘭與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽問題的談判仍在持續進行。外交部發言人 Esmaeil Baqaei 表示，只要「某些第三方」不加以阻撓，雙方聯合聲明目前已進入最終審閱與起草階段。
